note: 采访八百壮士的一天: who speaks how. The owner asked (26 Nov 2026) for each man's voice to carry the accent of his home. Two engines: ElevenLabs eleven_v4 ("el": public library voices) and CosyVoice 3 on the Mac ("cosy": instruct dialect, timbre from a reference clip of an ElevenLabs voice). Full 上海话 and 广东话 from CosyVoice came out unreadable to Whisper in the lab (26 Nov), so 谢晋元 speaks through a voice whose Mandarin has a Cantonese accent and the Shanghai reporter stays in standard Mandarin. Lines of three characters or fewer do not come out clean in CosyVoice: they are spoken by the reference voice itself ("short").
